The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to efficiently process the structural join operation, it is necessary to index the structural containment relationship on multiple nested tree levels, instead of just one.
, for a graph-structured XML, it is more efficient to index and evaluate the structural containment relationship on multiple nested tree layers rather than the whole graph.
